channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Meet the French streamer who absolutely loves Norwich City
item.description: A French streamer has been showing his love for Norwich City in live watchalongs of clubs games.

item.title: Investigation launched into spate of tool thefts
item.description: A spate of tool thefts across Norfolk is being investigated by police.

item.title: Christmas market at historic north Norfolk hall named best in country
item.description: The Holkham Hall Christmas Market has been named as the best in the country for affordability, according to a new study.

item.title: Bus shelter protest sparks extraordinary row between MP and council leader
item.description: The Sheringham bus shelter stand-off has sparked an extraordinary war of words between the town's MP and the leader of Norfolk County Council.

item.title: Police stand down search on the river after personal items found
item.description: Police have said they are standing down searches on the River Wensum but are appealing for information after personal items were discovered near Pigg Lane.

item.title: Image of man released after inappropriate comments made to teenage girl
item.description: Police have launched a stalking investigation after an older man made inappropriate comments to a teenage girl in Old Catton.

item.title: Live updates from crunch meeting to decide fate of Sheringham bus shelter
item.description: Live updates as crowds gather in Sheringham for an extraordinary town council meeting to discuss the demolition of a 1950s bus shelter.

item.title: County Hall accused of 'extortion' over bus shelter demolition threats
item.description: Sheringham Town Council has held an extraordinary meeting to discuss its position on plans to demolish a much-loved 1950s bus shelter, which has been the focus of a week-long sit-in protest.

item.title: People power wins out as town council votes to SAVE bus shelter
item.description: People power has won out in Sheringham as the town council has voted to save the bus shelter and to no longer support a regeneration scheme on its land following fierce protests.

item.title: Busy road closed in both directions after lorry overturns
item.description: The A143 at Haddiscoe is currently closed due to an overturned lorry.
